How do I move my position to the new contract when a futures contract rolls?

In `on_symbol_changed_events`, close the position in the expiring contract and open the same quantity in the new one:

def on_symbol_changed_events(self, symbols_changed: SymbolChangedEvents) -> None:
    for event in symbols_changed.values():
        expiring = self.symbol(event.old_symbol)
        held = self.portfolio[expiring].quantity
        if held == 0:
            continue
        self.liquidate(expiring, tag="roll")
        self.market_order(self.symbol(event.new_symbol), held, tag="roll")
